title: Implement RawAHashTable and AHashMap and AHashSet based on it

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
This PR adds RawAHashTable abstract class and bases the existing AHashMap on top of it. An AHashSet implementation is also added that is based on the RawAHashTable. AHashSet is a drop in replacement to the existing HashSet implementation.

This is done to lessen the issues mentioned in the godotengine/godot-proposals#12515 and is an execution of my [proposed solution](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/12515#issuecomment-3084266986) on the same thread.

This PR does not change any of the existing uses of the HashSet, except for the one in the `editor/animation/animation_blend_tree_editor_plugin.cpp`. A branch that changes all occurances of HashSet to AHashSet can be found [here](https://github.com/Brogolem35/godot/tree/rawahashtable_all) (may not compile in non-Linux platforms).

# Differences with HashSet

|                  | HashSet             | AHashSet            |
| ---------------- | ------------------- | ------------------- |
| Size             | Prime numbers       | Powers of 2         |
| Wrapping         | Fastmod or if check | Masking             |
| Metadata Storage | Structure of Arrays | Array of Structures |

# Benchmarks

## Hardware Specs:
OS: Linux 6.17.7-arch1-1
CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 4750G (16) @ 4.46 GHz
GPU: AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
RAM: F4-3200C16D-32GVK

## Basic bench:

The code used to measure can be found [here](https://github.com/Brogolem35/godot/tree/raw_bench). The unit of time used is clock cycles, got with use of `rdtscp`.  `rdtscp` is used instead of `rdtsc`, as `rdtsc` is susceptible to "out-of-order execution", while `rdtscp` is not.

### Results:

Warm access bench (no cache_flush): 
[bench_hot.csv](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23496329/bench_hot.csv)

Cold access bench (with cache_flush):
[bench_cold.csv](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23496342/bench_cold.csv)

### My Interpretation:

When it comes to insertion, in almost all cases the AHashSet outperforms HashSet. Sometimes with up to 30% difference.

In warm access, in some cases, there can be seen slight regressions regarding the lookup times, and improvements in other cases. In cold access, the lookup regressions are much more sparse to the point of being exceptions. 

I interpret this improvements are the result of AHashSet using AoS instead of SoA layout for metadata, thus better cold access, and the use of masking instead of fastmod or if checks for wrapping.

## Bunnymark:

[Gaijin Entertainment's Godot Bunnymark](https://github.com/GaijinEntertainment/godot-das/tree/master/examples/bunnymark) with [some changes](https://github.com/Brogolem35/gdscript-bunnymark). Used the release_template build from the [mentioned rawahashtable_all branch](https://github.com/Brogolem35/godot/tree/rawahashtable_all).

### Results:

The number next to HashSet/AHashSet indicates the number of starting bunnies.
